canonical_ratio: R=FUT^sin(phi_h+phi_s)/FUU under KPSY Eqs.3-5, with azimuths measured about the virtual-photon axis from the lepton plane and phi_s denoting target transverse spin.
input_normalization: Amplitude has already been divided by target spin magnitude and dilution. Raw count epsilon=f*P_T*DNN*A_Coll is outside this API; no f or P_T correction is performed.
selection: Required phase, normalization and nonblank source. No inference from experiment name, measured sign, fitted parameters or supplied scalar. The immutable carrier has no user-supplied angular-factor field.
fixed_y: Only DNN-included mode takes fixed 0<y<=1, DNN=2*(1-y)/(1+(1-y)^2). Booleans and fitted/dual settings are rejected. DNN-removed mode rejects y, preventing a second correction. At y=1 the included amplitude is zero; no inversion by zero DNN is performed.
averaging: This is a fixed-y prediction, including when a caller explicitly supplies a reported mean as an approximation. DNN(<y>) need not equal <DNN>, and <DNN*f*P_T> need not equal the product of means. Already corrected data receive no second correction. A finite P integral keeps y and all other kinematics fixed; no joint bin/acceptance average is inferred.
parameter_convention: The phase acts only on the final observable. It does not redefine h1 or Hhat3, repeat the KPSY-to-Trento relation Hhat3=-2*z*M_h*H1perp(1), change the J1 minus sign, introduce a mass/z factor, or change evolution.

primary_references.location: Fig.1 and Eqs.3-5; Eqs.55,58 separately define the KPSY/Trento Collins relation
primary_references.fact: Canonical spin-normalized sin(phi_h+phi_s) amplitude is DNN*R.

primary_references.location: Fig.2 and Collins-asymmetry definition; primary LaTeX source lines185-211 and597-623 in the reviewed source snapshot
primary_references.fact: Phi_C=phi_h+phi_S-pi; epsilon_C=f*P_T*DNN*A_Coll. The conditional same-axis phase conversion gives A_Coll=-R.

primary_references.location: Fig.1, Collins modulation definition and extraction discussion on journal page5
primary_references.fact: phi_Coll=phi_h+phi_S-pi and epsilon_Coll=DNN*f*P_T*A_Coll; extracted data have already been divided by mean(DNN*f*P_T). Species, source-version and nuclear gates remain separate.

validation_policy.threshold_source: config/leptonic-observable-contract.json validation_policy; all targets inherited unchanged
validation_policy.synthetic_projection: 256-bit adaptive Fourier projection of independently constructed positive counts N=1+DNN*R*sin(phi_h+phi_s), R=+/-1/8, y=2/5, three target-spin azimuths. Project onto the declared harmonic and divide by the known DNN only in removed mode. This reference never calls the implementation convention-factor function.
validation_policy.physical_inputs: Pinned CT10/DSSV08/DSS14 with explicit reference scale extrapolation. Point and finite P predictions, all13 parameter gradients and HVPs use independent scalar/BigFloat composition at shared fixed native rows. This checks the phase and normalization adapter, not an independent evolution solution or experimental admission.
validation_policy.counterfactuals: Retain unshifted-phase and repeated-DNN alternatives as demonstrably different at nonzero fixtures. Constructor and metadata mutation checks fail closed.
validation_policy.derivatives: Use inherited full13 inward direction, 256-bit references, finite-difference steps1e-4 and1e-5 and scaled derivative target1e-7 with floor1e-8. No thresholds are fitted to results.

limitations: Conditional same-axis mathematical phase/normalization conversion, not an experimental data-admission certificate
No raw-count spin/dilution correction, target-mass/longitudinal mixture or multidimensional acceptance integration
No unidentified-hadron mixture, deuteron nuclear prescription, covariance, nuisance or overlap decision
Historical reproduction, original author-code and homogeneous Collins-evolution limitations remain
No likelihood, production performance certification, uncertainty coverage or real-data extraction
